body:
Please take this feature request to [Rich Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) for approval before pursuing it as an issue. For a workaround, define a `RegexHighlighter` subclass with a named group for units and pass it to `Console(highlighter=...)`; see [Custom Highlighters](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/highlighting.rst).

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
